  AND resolved IS NULL
  AND issue_type LIKE '%Bug%'

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT  
      sprint_name,
      issue_type, 
      status, 
      story_points,
      release,
      resolved,
      COALESCE(split_part(split_part(assignee, ' ', 1), '.',1), 'UNASSIGNED') as assignee
   FROM jira_issues 
  WHERE story_points > 0
    AND COALESCE(assignee, 'UNASSIGNED') IN ($SELECTED_DEVS)
 ),
average_by_sprint AS (
    SELECT
        sprint_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN issue_type ILIKE '%Bug%' THEN story_points ELSE 0 END) AS points_of_bug,
        SUM(CASE WHEN issue_type ILIKE '%Bug%' THEN 0 ELSE story_points END) AS points_of_history
    FROM base
   WHERE sprint_name IN ($ALL_SPRINTS)
     AND resolved IS NOT NULL
   GROUP BY sprint_name
),
average AS (
    SELECT
        FLOOR(AVG(points_of_bug)) AS average_bugs,
        FLOOR(AVG(points_of_history)) AS average_history,
        (SELECT SUM(story_points) FROM base WHERE release LIKE '%$CURRENT_RELEASE%' AND resolved IS NULL) AS release_pending_points,
        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(story_points) FROM base WHERE release LIKE '%$CURRENT_RELEASE%' AND resolved IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('TO DO')), 0) AS release_in_process_points,
        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(story_points) FROM base WHERE release LIKE '%$CURRENT_RELEASE%' AND resolved IS NULL AND status IN ('TO DO')), 0) AS release_to_do_points,
        (SELECT SUM(story_points) FROM base WHERE release LIKE '%$CURRENT_RELEASE%') AS release_points
  FROM average_by_sprint
)
SELECT
  average_bugs AS "AVG BUG POINTS",
  average_history AS "AVG STORY POINTS",
  release_points AS "RELEASE TOTAL POINTS",
  (average_history * $NUMBER_OF_SPRINTS) AS "TEAM CAPACITY (POINTS)",
  ((average_history * $NUMBER_OF_SPRINTS) - release_points) as "DELTA",
  release_to_do_points AS "POINTS IN TO DO",
  release_in_process_points AS "POINTS IN PROGRESS",
  release_pending_points AS "REMAINING RELEASE POINTS",
  CASE WHEN release_pending_points / NULLIF(average_history, 0) >= 1 
       THEN ROUND(release_pending_points / NULLIF(average_history, 0), 0) 
       ELSE FLOOR(release_pending_points / NULLIF(average_history, 0)) 
       END AS "SPRINTS TO FINISH REMAINING",
       ROUND(release_points / NULLIF(average_history, 0), 1) AS "SPRINTS TO FINISH RELEASE"
FROM average;

  CASE WHEN release_pending_points / NULLIF(average_history, 0) >= 1 
       THEN ROUND(release_pending_points / NULLIF(average_history, 0), 0) 
       ELSE FLOOR(release_pending_points / NULLIF(average_history, 0))

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        sprint_name,
        COALESCE(split_part(split_part(assignee, ' ', 1), '.', 1), 'UNASSIGNED') AS dev,
        issue_type,
        story_points
    FROM public.jira_issues
    WHERE resolved IS NOT NULL
      AND story_points > 0
      AND sprint_name IN ($ALL_SPRINTS)
      AND COALESCE(assignee, 'UNASSIGNED') IN ($SELECTED_DEVS)
),
by_dev AS (
    SELECT
        sprint_name,
        dev,
        SUM(CASE WHEN issue_type ILIKE '%Bug%' THEN story_points ELSE 0 END) AS bug_points,
        SUM(CASE WHEN issue_type ILIKE '%Bug%' THEN 0 ELSE story_points END) AS story_points_done,
        FLOOR(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN issue_type ILIKE '%Bug%' THEN story_points ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(story_points), 0)) AS bug_pct
    FROM base
    GROUP BY sprint_name, dev
),
by_sprint AS (
    SELECT
        sprint_name,
        SUM(bug_points) AS total_bugs,
        SUM(story_points_done) AS total_releases,
        FLOOR(100.0 * SUM(bug_points) / NULLIF(SUM(bug_points + story_points_done), 0)) AS bug_pct_sprint
    FROM by_dev
    GROUP BY sprint_name
)

SELECT 
    d.sprint_name AS "SPRINT",
    s.total_bugs AS "BUGS",
    s.total_releases AS "RELEASE",
    s.total_bugs + s.total_releases AS "TOTAL"
FROM by_dev d
JOIN by_sprint s ON d.sprint_name = s.sprint_name
GROUP by d.sprint_name, s.total_bugs, s.total_releases, s.bug_pct_sprint
ORDER BY d.sprint_name;

panels.title: BUG VS STORY POINTS PER SPRINT

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
SELECT
	sprint_name,
	COALESCE(split_part(split_part(assignee, ' ', 1), '.', 1), 'UNASSIGNED') AS dev,
	issue_type,
	story_points
FROM public.jira_issues
WHERE resolved IS NOT NULL
 AND story_points > 0
 AND sprint_name IN ($ALL_SPRINTS)
 AND resolved IS NOT NULL
 AND COALESCE(assignee, 'UNASSIGNED') IN ($SELECTED_DEVS)
),
points_per_sprint AS (
    SELECT
        dev,
        sprint_name,
        SUM(story_points) AS sprint_points
    FROM base
    GROUP BY dev, sprint_name
),
avg_per_dev AS (
    SELECT
        dev,
        FLOOR(AVG(sprint_points)) AS avg_points
    FROM points_per_sprint
    GROUP BY dev
)
(
    SELECT
        dev,
        FLOOR(AVG(sprint_points)) AS avg_points
    FROM points_per_sprint
    GROUP BY dev
    ORDER By dev
)
UNION ALL
(
    SELECT  
    'OVERALL AVERAGE' AS dev,
    SUM(avg_points) AS avg_points
FROM avg_per_dev
)

WITH base AS (
SELECT
	sprint_name,
	COALESCE(split_part(split_part(assignee, ' ', 1), '.', 1), 'UNASSIGNED') AS dev,
	issue_type,
	story_points
FROM public.jira_issues
WHERE resolved IS NOT NULL
 AND story_points > 0
 AND sprint_name IN ($ALL_SPRINTS)
 AND assignee IN ($SELECTED_DEVS)
)
SELECT
    REPLACE(sprint_name, '$SPRINT_PREFIX - ', '') AS sprint_name,
    dev,
    SUM(story_points) AS points,                                -- points for this dev in this sprint
    ROUND(AVG(SUM(story_points)) OVER (PARTITION BY dev), 2) AS avg_per_dev, -- dev's average across all sprints
    SUM(SUM(story_points)) OVER (PARTITION BY sprint_name) AS sprint_total, -- total points in this sprint
    SUM(CASE WHEN issue_type ILIKE '%Bug%' THEN story_points ELSE 0 END) AS bug_points, -- bug points
    SUM(CASE WHEN issue_type ILIKE '%Bug%' THEN 0 ELSE story_points END) AS story_points_done, -- non-bug (story) points
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN issue_type ILIKE '%Bug%' THEN story_points ELSE 0 END)
        / NULLIF(SUM(story_points), 0),
        1
    ) AS bug_pct -- % of this dev's sprint points that were bugs
FROM base
GROUP BY sprint_name, dev
ORDER BY sprint_name, dev;
